sentences.text: This matter is taken up through virtual mode.

2. Heard Mr. P. Roy, learned counsel for the Petitioner and Miss S. Mishra, learned Addl. Standing Counsel for the State.
3.

The Petitioner is in custody since 16th November, 2021 in connection with Semiliguda P.S. Case No.108/2021 corresponding to G.R. Case No.71/2021 pending in the court of learned J.M.F.C,
Semiliguda for the alleged commission of the offence under Section 420/272/273/34 of the I.P.C.
read with Sections 51/52/56/57/59 of Food Safety and Standards Act.

// 2 //
4. Considering the submissions made, the materials on record, the period of detention already undergone and the fact that investigation into the case appears to have progressed substantially, I B.Ramesh vs State Of Odisha ....

5. Let the Petitioner be released on bail on such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the court in seisin over the matter in the aforesaid case including the condition that he shall appear before the trial court on each date of posting of the case without fail.

7. As the restrictions due to resurgence of COVID-19 situation are continuing, learned counsel for the parties may utilize a printout of the order available in the High court's website, at par with certified copy, subject to attestation by the concerned Advocate, in the manner prescribed vide Court's Notice No.4587, dated 25th March, 2020, modified by Notice No.4798, dated 15th April,
